title: Predicting visual memory across images and within individuals
authors: Cheyenne D. Wakeland-Hart, Steven A. Cao, Megan T. deBettencourt, Wilma A. Bainbridge, Monica D. Rosenberg
caption_short: (a) Experiment 1: continuous recognition of scene images shown for 0.75 s, with targets repeating at least 30 s later (n = 706). (b) Experiments 2 and 3 (n = 57): indoor / outdoor sorting of scenes shown for 1 s, then a self-paced recognition test on old and new scenes.
